visitor_intro: Hello! I am Mr Aliyu. I will teach our next chapter. First, show me what you learn with Ms Binta!
opening_teacher: Welcome, friends! Face the board. Let's learn to count together.
opening_aishatu: Welcome, Mr Aliyu! You can join our learning club.

model.teacher: Aishatu, touch each cup and say one number.
model.reply: I will start at the left. Count with me!

together.teacher: Grace, count the cups with me. Then tell us how many.
together.reply: I'll keep our cup record. Join in with us!

write.teacher: John, the written number can show how many cups you counted.
write.reply: Can we put our numbers in my picture book?

recall.teacher: Adamu, what do you remember about counting?
recall.reply: I touched one cup twice. Can we check together?

task_dialogue.heading: Aishatu's cups
task_dialogue.prompt: Count with me. Touch each cup once. Write how many.

task_dialogue.heading: Grace checks her record
task_dialogue.prompt: Please check this group with me. Count the cups. Write how many.

task_dialogue.heading: John's picture idea
task_dialogue.prompt: Let's draw a circle for each cup. You will draw two circles.

task_dialogue.heading: Grace writes the numbers
task_dialogue.prompt: Trace with me. Then write the numbers in the empty boxes.

task_dialogue.heading: John counts on his hand
task_dialogue.prompt: Hold up four fingers with me. Count them. Write how many.

task_dialogue.heading: Help Adamu start again
task_dialogue.prompt: I touched a cup twice. Show me how to count each cup just once.

scene_scope: Fictional classroom, four familiar pupils seated facing Ms Binta and the large board. Board instructions are typeset by code. No assessed quantities are taken from generated classroom artwork.
participation_scope: Aishatu initiates, Grace records and checks, John proposes a drawing and finger strategy, Adamu requests a counting repair. Ms Binta responds and leads; Mr Aliyu is introduced for the next chapter.
